routeComparison.title: Route aur TrueCost
routeComparison.subtitle: Compare fuel stops along your road route. Estimates depend on recorded prices and your assumptions.
routeComparison.locationDenied: Location share nahi hui. Shuru ka area chunein.
routeComparison.destinationHint: Pilot destinations: City Centre, Susan Road and D Ground. For another destination, enter its coordinates; general address search is not connected.
routeComparison.economyHint: Saved vehicle economy takes precedence. Without economy, only a valid fuel purchase estimate can be shown. CNG units are not supported.
routeComparison.privacy: Coordinates are used for this comparison and sent to the configured routing service, not saved to your account. Maps and external directions also share their viewed area with those services.
routeComparison.loadError: Comparison could not be loaded. Please retry.
routeComparison.vehicleError: Vehicles could not be loaded. You can still enter your own economy.
routeComparison.routeUnavailable: Road route comparison available nahi. Extra distance ya route total calculate nahi hua. Routing ko road route aur geometry deni hogi; pilot limit 150 km hai.
routeComparison.nearbyFallback: Find nearby stations without route comparison
routeComparison.coverage: Up to six recorded-fuel stations within 2 km of the road route are checked. This is not exhaustive coverage or a stock confirmation.
routeComparison.rankedTotal: Sorted by estimated total. Each option has a valid price and road detour.
routeComparison.rankedDistance: Sorted by added road distance, not claimed savings. Unroutable stations appear last.
routeComparison.noStations: Is route ke qareeb recorded fuel metadata wale eligible stations nahi mile. Maloomat na hona shortage ka saboot nahi.
routeComparison.detourFuel: Extra raste ke fuel ka andaza
routeComparison.referencePrice: Reviewed reference price, not a confirmed pump price
routeComparison.missingPrice: Valid reviewed price nahi. Fuel khareedne ki cost aur total maloom nahi.
routeComparison.viaUnavailable: Via-station road route unavailable. No added distance or detour fuel cost has been calculated.
routeComparison.priceExpired: Comparison ki price expire ho gayi. Dobara compare karein.
routeComparison.disclaimer: Estimates only, not guaranteed savings, live fuel stock, safe routes or arrival times. No verified redeemable offers are connected; discount is zero.
routeComparison.personalHint: Your figures only, separate from station results. This does not calculate a road detour or use a verified station price. No discount is applied.
routeComparison.priceChecked: I checked the source, amount and validity dates.

reasons.near_route: Included because recorded fuel metadata and location match the route corridor.
reasons.reference_price: Yeh reference price hai; is pump ki confirmed qeemat nahi.
reasons.station_price: Price is a reviewed, dated station-specific figure.
reasons.missing_price: Valid reviewed price nahi; monetary total nahi.
reasons.via_route_unavailable: Via route failed or was inconsistent with the direct route.
reasons.missing_economy: Economy missing hai; extra raste ka fuel cost calculate nahi ho sakta.
reasons.verified_offer: A verified eligible offer was applied.
reasons.no_verified_offer: Verified eligible offer nahi; discount zero.
reasons.unverified_details: Station details have not been human-verified.
reasons.ranked_total: Ranked by estimated total, not a promise of savings.
reasons.ranked_distance: Price ya economy adhoori ho to kam extra road distance pehle aata hai.

discovery.areaHint: Pilot areas: City Centre, Susan Road aur D Ground. Doosre areas abhi shamil nahi.
discovery.locationPrivacy: Location dena optional hai. Search coordinates account mein save nahi hote. Map kholne par nazar aane wala area map service ko jata hai.
discovery.petrolReports: Petrol ki reports dikh rahi hain. Doosra fuel chun kar uski reports dekhein.
discovery.radius: {radius} km ke andar; zyada se zyada 50 qareebi results.
discovery.noFuelMetadata: Is filter ke liye insani tasdeeq shuda fuel types aur tasdeeq ki tareekh chahiye. Unknown ka matlab fuel khatam nahi. Ghair tasdeeq shuda records ke liye All chunein.
discovery.noVerifiedTitle: In nataij mein koi tasdeeq shuda station nahi
discovery.noVerifiedMessage: Station ke naam, pin aur fuel types ko tareekh ke saath insani jaanch chahiye. Neeche ke records sirf ghair tasdeeq shuda leads hain. Yeh maloomat ki kami hai, fuel ki kami ka saboot nahi.
discovery.notGuaranteed: Reports mehdood waqt ke liye hain; pohanchne par fuel ki guarantee nahi.
discovery.checked: Maine pin, fuel types aur station details check ki hain.
